title: Machine learning and WGCNA nominate AK3 as a prognostic gene in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
summary: A comprehensive machine-learning survival-model screen (including random survival forest) with WGCNA selected hypoxia- and angiogenesis-related prognostic genes including AK3, validated for the signature in the E-MTAB-1980 cohort. AK3 was downregulated in ccRCC with poor prognosis, and its overexpression suppressed proliferation and migration via PI3K/AKT/GSK3b, reduced tumours in nude mice and increased oxaliplatin sensitivity. The choice of AK3 may be partly literature-driven, machine learning is one step, and effect sizes were not read.
ai_technology: Random survival forest, plsRcox and survival SVM combinations with WGCNA

evidence.tested: E-MTAB-1980 external cohort plus tissue, cell-line and nude-mouse experiments on AK3.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning survival models screened candidate prognostic genes.
